falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows would invalidate the 77% bottom pattern match, as that prior bottom held at ~4,800; this would signal the current structure is weaker and not a valid analog

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom saw VIX peak near 28; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic escalation beyond the referenced pattern, proving this is not a comparable bottoming environment but rather a deeper liquidation phase

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.50% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A flight-to-safety bid this aggressive would signal recession/deleveraging fears overwhelming the current 'HOLD' signal; the August 2024 bottom occurred with yields stable-to-higher, so this divergence breaks the pattern validity

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
